entries.en: Looks like your recipes have reached[n]housewife-level quality. You trying to[n]get hitched sometime soon?

entries.en: I'll warn you not to try any pranks[n]with Wakaba...

entries.en: It'll only blow up in your face—she'll tease[n]you forever until she finally bores herself.

entries.en: I can't remember the last time I actually[n]got to relax and enjoy myself on a New[n]Year's like this.

Morgana is supposed to be[n]a cat... And Wakaba, she...[n]shouldn't be here with us...

entries.en: My apologies—I merely wished to speak[n]with [lName]-kun for a moment.

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.en: I'll stand guard over your dessert for you.

entries.en: You say that now, but when he gets back[n]and his dessert's gone, I'm pretty sure[n]he'll suspect it was an inside job.
